readme: Verified macro rows for R100 build. Every row checked 2026-07-18 against USDA FoodData Central values (via USDA-mirroring nutrition databases) or a mainstream US product label. needs_verify=false means confirmed or corrected; verify_source names the authority. 2 corrections: Ground Pork and Hummus (see correction_note on those rows). Sanity rule calories ~= 4*protein + 4*carbs + 9*fat holds within label rounding on all rows.

items.verify_source: Universal US salt label (Morton): sodium only, 0 cal/0 macros; USDA salt has no protein/carb/fat
USDA spices, black pepper: 5-6 cal per 1 tsp (2.3g) via fatsecret/nutritionvalue USDA mirrors

items.correction_note: CORRECTED from 70 cal/5F. The authored row used typical classic-hummus values (Sabra Classic: 2 tbsp/28g = 70 cal, 2P, 4C, 5F), but the row is branded Great Value classic, and three independent mirrors of the GV label agree it is 15 cal per tbsp (much less tahini/oil). If a recipe uses Sabra or generic hummus, use 70/2/4/5 instead

items.verify_source: Athenos Crumbled Feta label: 1/4 cup (28g) 70 cal, ~5P, 1C, 6F (eatthismuch); USDA feta 264 cal/100g -> 28g = 74 cal, 4P, 1.1C, 6F - matches
80/20 fresh ground pork retail label (SmartLabel product 6066387; same values across Never Any!, Open Nature, supermarketlabels 80/20 SKUs): 4 oz (112g) 280 cal, 20P, 0C, 22F
items.correction_note: CORRECTED from 290 cal/17P/24F. The typical US 80/20 ground pork label is 280 cal with 20g protein and 22g fat per 4 oz; authored row understated protein by 3g (>15%) and overstated fat. 4*20+9*22=278, checks out
